**What type of PR is this?**
/kind feature


**What this PR does / why we need it**:
We currently only have metrics for each schedule attempt. However, a pod could be retried with multiple attempts before being scheduled. We'd like to understand per-pod metrics instead of just per-attempt.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
<!--
*Automatically closes linked issue when PR is merged.
Usage: `Fixes #<issue number>`, or `Fixes (paste link of issue)`.
_If PR is about `failing-tests or flakes`, please post the related issues/tests in a comment and do not use `Fixes`_*
-->
Fixes #83412 #83415

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:
<!--
If no, just write "NONE" in the release-note block below.
If yes, a release note is required:
Enter your extended release note in the block below. If the PR requires additional action from users switching to the new release, include the string "action required".

For more information on release notes see: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/guide/release-notes.md
-->
```release-note
Add per-pod scheduling metrics across 1 or more schedule attempts.
```

**Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.**:

Please use the following format for linking documentation:

- [Usage]: <link>
- [Other doc]: <link>
-->
```docs

```

issue_context.title: Add a metric to track duration of a pod being scheduled successfully
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:

metric name | metric definition | Description
-- | -- | --
pod_scheduling_duration_seconds | Type: Histogram | E2e latency for a pod being scheduled which may include multiple scheduling attempts

**Why is this needed**:
Currently we don't know how long does it to schedule a pod e2e.

/sig scheduling
/assign liu-cong

review_comments: this infinite loop is hard to read and reason about, I am pretty sure there is a waitUntil function that we can use instead of this logic, would be great if we can clean this up in a followup PR.
SG. There is a comment for this `Note that this is extremely rudimentary and we need a more real error handling path.` There might be a chance to further refactor this.
I am going to create a PR for this.
the klog.Errorf on the previous line is redundant, we already log info on an error inside ```bindVolumes```, perhaps delete this and change that to klog.Error?
Removed err from log. Added pod ns/name.
why do we need to log two lines? lets just do it once here it is easier to grep if it is a single line.
ditto to the one above as well.
Sorry I didn't realize that the error reason is already provided to recordSchedulingFailure. Removed redundant log lines. And I found an existing redundant log which is removed as well!
the klog.Error is redundant, we already log error inside assume
